yācaka.cp: masc. a beggar; one who requests.
yācaka.p: [Yāca+ṇviu] (ti) CL=7 [In Thī  yācikā. Yācaka-saṃ. Jāyaka-pākata.]   (1) One who requests/asks (or) One who beg.    (2) (A) Offerings (or) Donations. (B) Beggar, Beggar, Beggar, Beggar Yācakā. (3) (A) One who is urge respectfully. (B) One who pays obeisance with one's hands clasped palm and raised to touch one's forehead. (4) Asking to accept something (Saddattha),should be accepted (Building/Lounge)(Adhippāyattha-upacārattha). Yācana-(C)-See also. See original.

[ယာစ+ဏွို။ ထီ-၌ ယာစိကာ။ ယာစက-သံ။ ဇာယက-ပါကတ။]

P: Yācaka，（adj．n．） [fr．yāca，cp．Epic & later Sk．yācaka] requesting，one who begs，a recipient of alms，a beggar J．III，353； Pv．II，938； PvA．78，102 （=yācanaka）； Sdhp．324，331．Freq．in combn with similar terms of wayfaring people in phrase samaṇa-brāhmaṇa-kapaṇ’iddhika-vaṇibbaka-yācakā e．g．at D．I，137； It．64．See single terms．-- yācaka at Sn．618 （as Fick，Soc．Gliederung 144 quotes yācaka） is to be read yājaka．（Page 552）

yācana.p: [Yāca+yu+.(thī,na)yācana-saṃ] (ti) CL=7 [Jāyaṇa-prā. Jāyaṇā-pākata.] (1) One who ask for something with oral. (B) One who ask for something with (deed). (2) (A) One who ask for something ,offerings with respect.(3) Prohibition with request. (C) One who urge respectfully (codanattha).(3) Urge (codanattha).(4) One who ask for something ,offerings. (asking to get something. Jā, 1. 104. Jāta, vatthu, 2, sya, 713-nhā).(5)Things which should be asked for offering. (6) Should be  asked for something offerings with respect. (7) (Words) which express for urge, (8) Asking for something offerings (saddattha), (The building) got due to ask. (Adhippāyattha= upacārattha).

yācanta.cp: pr.p. of yācati. begging; asking; entreating.
yācanta.p: [Yāca+anta.thī-၌yācanti.] (ti) CL=7 (1) One who begs/ask for something. (2)(A) One who want to ask/beg with respect. (B) One who is expression of apology (such as to a monk for one's inability to offer). (C) One who want to urge with respect. (3) One who urges. (4) One who is longing. See original.

yācati.p: [Yāca+a+ti] (kri) CL=7 [Yācate, yācati-saṃ. Jāyai-pākata.] (1) (A) Ask for something (with deed (or) with body language (or) expression with body). (B) Expression of apology. (B) Expression of apology to a monk for one's inability to offer. (3) Urge.(Codanattha). (4) Making a wish to get it (or) Longing for it. (5) Take refuge in. (6) Give (impression/sign). (7) Asking for (things which is already offered) again. See original.

yācayoga.cp: adj. accessible to begging; ready to comply with another's request.
yācayoga.p: [Yāca+yoga] (ti) CL=7 [In Thi  yācayogā, yācayogī.] (1) One who was pleaded with respest and relate with beings eligible at all times. (Buddha) See - Yāca-(5). (2) One who is suitable  to plead/ beseech/entreat (Buddha). See - Yāca-(6). (3) Ask for something, One who is suitable to ask. See - Yāca-(3). (4) One who is related with (Accepted person from donors, Beggars) who are asking for something at all times. See - Yāca-(4). (5) One who is ralated with offerings at all times. (Male donor). See - Yāca-(7).

D: Yācayoga，【形】 容易取得的恳求，预备照做其他人的请求。（p261）
F: Yācayoga，【形】有求必应，照他人的请求（accessible to begging，one ready to comply with another’s request）。SnA 414．︰Yācayogoti yācituṁ yutto． Yo hi yācake disvāva bhakuṭiṁ katvā pharusavacanādīni bhaṇati，so na yācayogo hoti．（照他人的请求︰照乞求给。若是见到的乞求者，轻薄、言语粗鲁，他就不会有求必应。）

yāci.p: [Yāca+ī(ī-ki] () CL=7 [Rassa-pru. Rū. 469).] (1) has already asked for. See - Yācati-(1-A). (2) (A) Has already asked respectfully. See - Yācati-(2-A). (B) Has requested and prohibited. See - Yācati-(2-B). (C) has respectful urged/reminded. See - Yācati-(2-B). (3) has been urged/reminded. See - Yācati-(3). (4) has been longing for and make wishing for it. See - Yācati-(4).

yācikā.p: [Yāca+ṇvu+ā] (thī) CL=7 Yācikā-thi bhāvasādhano. Kaṅkhā, ṭī, saca. 237. One way - (yāca+a+ā=) yācā+ṇika+ā. Ṇika- meaningless. (It is in Hāraka-puda Ṇvu- meaning of paccaññaḥkaṃ for showing about it in Kaṅkhā, ṭī, saca. 215, In Sāratta, 2. 258 , show Ka-paccaññaḥ  meaningless due to unlike it is being in Ṇa-paccaññaḥ kaṃ meaning. Like that, in Ī, unlike it is being Cvu-paccaññaḥ in bhāvasādhana , show next way for that). [Yācikā-saṃ.] Asking for something/ Begging  (saddatta),Accepted (Building) due to ask/beg. (adhippāyattha-upacārattha). See them - Yācana, yācaka-(4).
a: ယာစိကာ-ထိ ဘာဝသာဓနော။ ကင်္ခါ၊ ဋီ၊ သစ်။ ၂၃၇။ တစ်နည်း(ယာစ+အ+အာ=)ယာစာ+ဏိက+အာ။ ဏိက-အနက်မဲ့။(ဟာရက-ပုဒ်၌ဏွု-ပစ္စည်းကံအနက်၌ ဖြစ်သည်ဟု ကင်္ခါ၊ ဋီ၊ သစ်။ ၂၁၅-၌ ပြသည်။ သာရတ္တ၊ ၂။ ၂၅၈-၌ ကား။ ဏွု-ပစ္စည်း ကံအနက်၌ ဖြစ်ခြင်းကို မနှစ်သက်သဖြင့် ဏ-ပစ္စည်း ကံအနက်၌ဖြစ်၍ က-ပစ္စည်း အနက်မဲ့ဟု ပြ သည်။ ထိုအတူဤ၌လည်း စွု-ပစ္စည်း ဘာဝသာဓန၌ ဖြစ်ခြင်းကို မနှစ်သက်နိုင် သူတို့အတွက် နောက်နည်းကိုပြသည်)။ယာစိကာ-သံ။] တောင်းခြင်း(သဒ္ဒတ္တ)၊ တောင်း-တောင်း၍ ရ-အပ်သော(အဆောက်အဦ)(အဓိပ္ပါယတ္ထ-ဥပစာရတ္ထ)။ ယာစန, ယာစက-(၎)-တို့ကြည့်။

[ယာစ+ဏွု+အာ။ ယာစိကာ-ထိ ဘာဝသာဓနော။ ကင်္ခါ၊ ဋီ၊ သစ်။ ၂၃၇။ တစ်နည်း （ယာစ+အ+အာ=）ယာစာ+ဏိက+အာ။ ဏိက-အနက်မဲ့။ （ဟာရက-ပုဒ်၌ဏွု-ပစ္စည်းကံအနက်၌ ဖြစ်သည်ဟု ကင်္ခါ၊ ဋီ၊ သစ်။ ၂၁၅-၌ ပြသည်။ သာရတ္တ၊ ၂။ ၂၅၈-၌ ကား။ ဏွု-ပစ္စည်း ကံအနက်၌ ဖြစ်ခြင်းကို မနှစ်သက်သဖြင့် ဏ-ပစ္စည်း ကံအနက်၌ဖြစ်၍ က-ပစ္စည်း အနက်မဲ့ဟု ပြ သည်။ ထိုအတူဤ၌လည်း စွု-ပစ္စည်း ဘာဝသာဓန၌ ဖြစ်ခြင်းကို မနှစ်သက်နိုင် သူတို့အတွက် နောက်နည်းကိုပြသည်）။ယာစိကာ-သံ။]

yācita.cp: pp. of yācati. asked of; begged of.
yācita.p: [Yāca+ta] (ti) CL=7 [Yācita-saṃ-jāia-prā.] (1) (A) One who is asking for something. (B) One who is asking for something (with speech, with oral). (C) One who is asking for something (asking way of Ariya - go round village or town to accept offerings of food). (2) Should be asked respectfully, (A) Discipline.(B)Thing wished (or) Prayed for (or) Desired. (3) (A) Should be urged respectfully, (B) One who is  special urge respectfully . (4) One who should be urged. (5) One who should be asked permission. (6) Should be asked for (Things, Property). (7) To ask for something (amoment (or) temporarily) -(A) (Objects, Articles) (monk's bowl, robe). (B) (Bhikkhu, Novice, People). (8) One who used to ask for alms , offerings (Bhikkhu). (9) One who should be asked respectfully (Rahantā/Arahat). (Na) (10) To ask for something (to borrow for amoment).  (11) (A) Urging/Reminding respectfully. (B) Especially urge with respect. (12) (Time, Period) when it is urged/reminded respectfully. See original.

a: ယာစိတ-ကေနာတိဧတ္ထ ဟုတွာ ဂဟိတော ယာစိတကောတိ ဒဿေန္တောအာဟ'ယာစိတွာ ဂဟိတေနာ' တိ။ ပါစိတ်၊ ယော။ ၂၆၈။(-ဝိ၊ဋ္ဌ၊၃။၃ဝ၇။မဟာနိ၊ဋ္ဌ။၂၇-တို့၌ အဓိပ္ပါယ်ဖွင့်ဟု ယူသင့်သည်)။ ယာ စိတေန နိဗဣတ္တံယာယစိတကံ၊ ကပ္ပဒ္ဒုမ။] (၁)(အခိုက်အတန့်-ခဏခေတ္တ-တောင်း၍-တောင်းခြင်းဖြင့်-ယူအပ်-ရအပ်-သော)ငှါ-ချေးငှါး-ငှါးရမ်း-အပ် သော(ပစ္စည်း, ဥစ္စာ)။(၂)တောင်း-တောင်းခံ-အပ်သော(ပစ္စည်းဥစ္စာ)။(၃)တောင်းပန်-ရိုသေစွာ-တိုက်တွန်း-အပ်သော၊ သူ။(ဘိက္ခုနီသံဃာ)။(၎)တိုက် တွန်း-နှိုးဆော်-အပ်သော၊ သူ။
